justifications.fit: the new switch at tests/test_mast_centroid_panel_states.py:32 follows the existing SLOT_CONTROL_ENV idiom at line 28, and the names _memoized_state_display and _BUILD_DISPLAY carry no plan or version label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the panels and their receipts under docs/figures/mast-centroid-capability/ were already drawn at base 5c503f9a8, so tests/test_mast_centroid_panel_states.py:172-178 verifies the goal rather than performing the redraw the brief names.
justifications.reuse: the memoization at tests/test_mast_centroid_panel_states.py:105-115 wraps the producer's own entry point benchmarks/mast_centroid_solve_panels.py:1158 rather than forking a second display-map path, and the search found no display-map cache owner in nova/equilibrium/display_flux.py.
